description: CORHEL-CME combines tools and simulation codes for modelling coronal mass ejections in a solar-wind environment. A web workflow guides users through setting up flux ropes and running physics-based scenarios. The resource is documented by Predictive Science. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented interface permits no more than two flux ropes in one run. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
